movie_title: What happens if an engineered virus escapes the lab?
introduction: How do we keep labs that handle dangerous pathogens safe and leak-free? Dig into the ongoing debate

vocabulary.definition: measures taken to prevent the accidental release of biological agents from a laboratory or other facility
vocabulary.example: Strict biosecurity protocols are in place to prevent any contamination from occurring in the lab.

vocabulary.definition: an infectious disease caused by spore-forming bacteria, typically affecting livestock but can also be transmitted to humans
vocabulary.example: The lab was dealing with a dangerous strain of anthrax that posed a significant risk to the workers.

vocabulary.definition: a disease prevalent over a whole country or the world
vocabulary.example: The COVID-19 outbreak was declared a pandemic by the World Health Organization.

vocabulary.definition: scientists who study viruses and viral diseases
vocabulary.example: Leading virologists are working tirelessly to develop effective vaccines against emerging viral threats.

vocabulary.definition: able to be passed from one person or organism to another
vocabulary.example: The new strain of the virus was highly transmissible, leading to a rapid spread of the infection.

vocabulary.definition: official procedures or system of rules governing affairs of state or diplomatic occasions
vocabulary.example: It is essential to follow the established protocols to ensure the safety and integrity of the experiment.
